executor.name: wowmax-stellar-router
executor.description: On-chain swap-plan executor: atomic split + multi-hop + cross-protocol across Soroswap, Aquarius, Phoenix, plus swap_merge, which executes the route as topologically-ordered stages, splitting each token's pooled balance once across its pools (on-chain fan-in). Output is measured as the contract's own token_out balance delta on every entry point, hop-to-hop token continuity is validated, and amount_out_min is enforced on the summed output. The contract has no admin and no upgrade path.

superseded.note: Original executor. Superseded by CBLMXS6U…: the current build adds swap_merge and the balance-delta accounting, so a single deployment now covers both roles. Contracts are immutable; replacement is by redeployment.
